findings_and_questions.kind: Existing prior /root/hair_ops candidate independently reconnected; no new count
findings_and_questions.observation: JunctionBond publicly stores raw f32 minimum area and maximum penetration and derives Deserialize; some producers write numerical expressions directly. Measured area is separately admitted as finite nonnegative Area, but fits compares it to the raw declared minimum and raw penetration limit. A directly supplied finite negative minimum makes that particular area conjunct trivially true for a finite nonnegative measured area, not the whole bond or building audit. The overlap validation separately requires a positive declared minimum and a second tower-chord alternative exists.
findings_and_questions.qualification: Supported decoded/direct/generated bad thresholds, overflow, invalid geometry, and a passing audit have not been demonstrated. The previous 2679 finding retains attribution and conditions; PL13-031 and the current central bearing-area trace concern related but independently reasoned threshold and overlap-area contracts. No automatic alias or duplicate unique count.
findings_and_questions.future_repair_direction: After audit and explicit repair authorization, determine finite/sign/zero threshold policy and canonical owner; carry appropriate area/penetration values through producers while preserving tolerated gaps, graph identity and other actual acceptance checks.

findings_and_questions.kind: Conditional identity/aggregate policy question; central alias and count pending
findings_and_questions.observation: StructuralNode exposes id, parents and grounded; ResolvedGeometry exposes a Vec and lookup node(id) selects the first matching node. The resolved audit collects node pairs into a HashMap keyed by id and GroundSupport walks that resulting map, so duplicates collapse in that map rather than representing both nodes; the separate lookup uses the first vector match. A duplicate-id plan with differing records can therefore have ambiguous or inconsistent node selection unless another admission boundary ensures uniqueness.
findings_and_questions.qualification: This is a source-supported conditional mismatch, not proof that a supported generated, authored or decoded plan contains duplicate IDs, that HashMap chooses a particular duplicate, that an actual audit passes, or that no other check exists. 774 native RootF001 public mutable graph condition and 059 TEAM020 first-match identity question are related; no alias or separate count presumed.
findings_and_questions.future_repair_direction: Trace all supported plan admissions and node producers, establish uniqueness and stable ID-to-record policy at the owning aggregate, then align lookups and graph audit if needed; preserve grounded terminal-node semantics.

findings_and_questions.kind: Conditional junction witness semantics / policy question; no new unique count
findings_and_questions.observation: Per-overlap validation tests owner membership, bond bounds, penetration and a merely positive declared area. The later per-bond check separately asks whether any solid pair of those owners produces matching geometry/area, or takes the explicit tower-chord alternative. A bond has owner IDs rather than solid IDs; with multiple contacts among the same owners, the pair used as the area witness need not be the pair encountered in the overlap loop.
findings_and_questions.qualification: It is not established that supported geometry can reach two distinct pair contacts inside a bond, that each pair rather than an owner-level junction needs a separate area witness, or that any actual audit accepts an invalid plan. This differs in first question from the central measured overlap-area formula and prior raw threshold admission, but exact canonical identity/aliases remain central.
findings_and_questions.future_repair_direction: Resolve whether area belongs to an individual pair, unioned contact, or owner-level declared region and trace all bond producers/consumers before changing the aggregate or tolerance policy.

findings_and_questions.kind: Scoped source disposition and open aggregate question
findings_and_questions.observation: Node from_metres and custom Deserialize pass through Position::from_metres and attach node ID to its error, so those routes check finiteness. Typed new trusts Position without readmission; its backing fields are pub(super), leaving the historically recorded RootF003 lower-owner invariant question open. SupportInterface uses admitted ordered finite bounds; zero extent is allowed at that owner, with positive bearing checked at its consumer. Drainage records contain typed IDs and separately stored geometry/recipient/downspout options, while RoofDrainageRecipient already owns its parent-face payload.
findings_and_questions.qualification: Leaf validation does not establish aggregate references, location, topology, drainage routing, chronology or coherence. Zero interface height and optional free-drip/downspout combinations are not automatically errors; actual producer/audit reachability and intended policy remain open. 774 native batch3 RootF001/RootF003 relationships remain historical, not additional findings.
findings_and_questions.future_repair_direction: Trace actual drainage station producer, retained references and audit/consumers before proposing aggregate validation; preserve legitimate free-drip and zero-extent admission.

thirteen_lenses.producer-propagation: StructuralNode position is admitted at from_metres/serde, while drainage vectors and bond limits remain raw in retained records; selected actual producers and receiving audit are separately traced.
thirteen_lenses.existing-type-owners: Position<Architectural>, SpatialBounds, Area and SignedLength have distinct finite/frame/sign policies; Area admits zero and SignedLength permits negative, so owner reuse needs actual threshold policy.
thirteen_lenses.admission-contracts: Node raw factory and manual Deserialize route through Position admission; typed new relies on the already typed value and historical RootF003 leaves its lower backing routes open. Other public graph and bond relationships remain separately unchecked at this leaf. SupportInterface deliberately permits zero-height bounds before bearing.
thirteen_lenses.invariant-operations: Bounds finite ordering does not certify finite results after arithmetic without readmission. Measured area and penetration are checked while bond raw thresholds and selected producers need separate contract proof.
thirteen_lenses.aggregate-states: IDs, parents, grounded status, support interfaces, bond bounds and drainage references have relationships a checked position alone cannot establish; the node HashMap may collapse duplicate keys.
thirteen_lenses.type-ownership: Geometry and actual generation/audit owners retain physical state; measurement and thresholds are related distinct concepts. No claim that all existing units or graph types have identical semantics.
thirteen_lenses.redundant-authority: Current overlap and per-bond checks ask different related questions with potentially different witness pairs; whether that difference is intentional is unresolved. Do not merge analysis solely by shared contact.
thirteen_lenses.behavior-preservation: Preserve legitimate zero extents at admission, grounded terminal semantics, signed offsets, tolerated gap planes, free drip and tower-chord distinct modes. No obsolete compatibility path added.
thirteen_lenses.enum-shapes: RoofDrainageRecipient already attaches parent face/roof payload; disposition and optional fields may need a coherent aggregate only after real mode policy is proven. grounded is an ordinary predicate in the examined graph.
thirteen_lenses.derivability: Manual node deserialization uses fallible checked constructor and error ownership, not unnecessary boilerplate. Derived serde for raw graph fields does not itself prove decoded aggregate admission.
thirteen_lenses.granularity: Separate position from displacement and finite area from signed length; observer should distinguish ID lookup, owner-pair vs solid-pair witnesses, and a declared area threshold from measured contact.
thirteen_lenses.magic-strings: The assigned graph and bond body has no private string classifier. Serde snake_case is a native wire format and diagnostic issue strings are final output; no protocol verdict inferred.
thirteen_lenses.magic-numbers: Area and contact tolerances carry different units; fixed roof 0.005 area and penetration limits belong to separate producer and audit policy. No arbitrary global epsilon substitution or blanket value deduplication.
